-- store/store.go --
package store

type DB struct{ Addr string }

//fabrik:provider
func NewDB() *DB { return &DB{Addr: "primary"} }

//fabrik:provider name=replica
func NewReplicaDB() *DB { return &DB{Addr: "replica"} }

//fabrik:inject DB name=replica
type Deps struct {
	DB *DB
}

//fabrik:provider
func NewDeps(db *DB) *Deps { return &Deps{DB: db} }

//fabrik:inject DB name=replica
type Wiring struct {
	DB *DB
}

//fabrik:provider
func NewWiring(db *DB) Wiring { return Wiring{DB: db} }

//fabrik:inject DB name=replica
type Spare struct {
	DB *DB
}

//fabrik:provider name=spare
func NewSpare(db *DB) *Spare { return &Spare{DB: db} }
